User Story: Venue Staff records a venue day for coordinators
Acceptance Criteria: Staff can save available or unavailable periods for a selected date
Test Scenario: Happy: staff drag and save a period; error: coordinator write denied; boundary: opening time accepted
Pre-Conditions: Venue 7 has 08:00–22:00 hours and staff credentials
Test Steps: Select venue and date; drag a block and optionally override its status; save; attempt same write as coordinator
Expected Results: Staff save commits one venue-local day; coordinator receives 403
Test Details: A wrong venue ID, role bypass, or missing write fails the payload and HTTP assertions.

User Story: Venue Staff edits a saved venue day
Acceptance Criteria: A successful edit replaces the previous schedule
Test Scenario: Happy: replace prior day rows; error: failed insert rolls back; boundary: empty replacement deletes all explicit periods
Pre-Conditions: Venue 7 has an existing schedule on 2030-10-10
Test Steps: Move or delete a block; save; simulate insert failure in a separate case
Expected Results: Only new rows persist after commit; failure preserves old rows
Test Details: A partial delete or append-only implementation fails persisted-row and rollback assertions.

User Story: Venue Staff works within operating hours
Acceptance Criteria: Outside operating hours is automatically unavailable
Test Scenario: Happy: unmarked 08:00–22:00 shows available; error: malformed hours reject save; boundary: 00:00–08:00 and 22:00–24:00 show unavailable
Test Steps: Open the day view; inspect timeline segments; submit with invalid venue hours
Expected Results: Closed time is shaded and announced as unavailable; invalid hours cannot save
Test Details: Removing synthetic closed-hour blockers or accepting malformed hours fails accessible segment and validation assertions.

User Story: Venue Staff cannot make closed hours available
Acceptance Criteria: Save rejects availability outside hours and explains the permitted window
Test Scenario: Happy/boundary: exact 08:00 start and 22:00 end pass; error/boundary: 07:59 start and 22:01 end fail
Test Steps: Submit each endpoint variant through validation and save route
Expected Results: Outside variants receive 400 or visible error containing 08:00–22:00; endpoints pass
Test Details: An off-by-one comparator fails the just-below, exact, and just-above assertions.

User Story: Venue Staff supplies valid schedule data
Acceptance Criteria: Missing fields, invalid dates, nonpositive durations and overlaps block saving
Test Scenario: Happy/boundary: adjacent periods pass; error: missing date/status/time, impossible date, zero/reversed time, overlap and invalid venue ID fail
Pre-Conditions: Venue 7 has recorded hours and staff credentials
Test Steps: Submit invalid and adjacent payloads; inspect errors and unchanged stored rows
Expected Results: Relevant 400 or inline error appears; no invalid save commits
Test Details: A vacuous validator fails explicit rejection and no-commit checks; adjacency protects half-open behavior.

Acceptance Criteria: Closing confirmed occupied time is blocked and affected bookings display
Test Scenario: Happy/boundary: adjacent closure allowed; error/boundary: one-minute overlap blocked; pending hold may be closed but late approval fails
Pre-Conditions: Confirmed booking 10:00–11:00 with 30-minute setup and 15-minute turnaround
Test Steps: Attempt closures around occupied endpoints; attempt API save; inspect affected event; verify late approval
Expected Results: 409 identifies affected booking; no replacement commits; recorded availability never overrides booking
Test Details: Ignoring buffers or booking status fails asymmetric boundary and real PostgreSQL conflict assertions.

User Story: Staff and coordinators see saved schedule
Acceptance Criteria: Both roles see persisted availability and unavailability on next view
Test Scenario: Happy: both roles read replacement and reason; error: expired hold hidden; boundary: booked setup/turnaround rendered
Pre-Conditions: Venue 7 day is saved and both roles have credentials
Test Steps: Save; fetch through both roles; inspect labelled timeline segments and unavailable block
Test Data: 2030-10-10; unavailable 12:00–13:00 labelled Floor cleaning; booked 10:00–11:00 plus buffers
Expected Results: Both roles receive saved rows, readable reason and correct effective availability
Test Details: Mock-free PostgreSQL reads catch an in-memory-only save; accessible timeline tests catch stale hold and missing buffer display.

User Story: Venue Staff opens one selected venue schedule
Acceptance Criteria: View details opens only the chosen venue profile; its schedule appears after View schedule is pressed inside the drawer
Test Scenario: Happy: drawer action opens LazadaOne schedule; error: premature schedule request, wrong venue and redundant card action are absent; boundary: missing venue ID rejected by write route
Pre-Conditions: Staff dashboard has two venue cards
Test Steps: Check each card has only the rightmost View details action; open the first profile; confirm schedule hidden; press drawer View schedule; inspect heading and API path
Expected Results: No schedule appears or loads before the drawer action; afterward only venue 7 schedule opens and receives requests
Test Details: An eager schedule fetch, duplicate card action or stale selected ID fails the visibility, request, heading and route assertions.

User Story: Venue Staff reads a venue timeline
Acceptance Criteria: Time runs horizontally and the selected venue occupies one row
Test Scenario: Happy: one venue row and day ticks visible with full-height unavailability; error: adjacent-day record omitted; boundary: closed ends shaded
Pre-Conditions: A venue-local date and operating hours are selected
Test Steps: Open timeline; inspect row, tick, full-height block and locked markers
Expected Results: One named row spans the local day; an unavailable bar fills its row
Test Details: Computed production CSS fails if the block regains its old top inset; grid and marker assertions catch wrong-day records.

User Story: Venue Staff drags blocks to enter a schedule
Acceptance Criteria: Horizontal drag creates unavailable periods with an optional short reason inside the timeline
Test Scenario: Happy: 10:00–11:00 drag accepts Floor cleaning and saves; error: separate agenda and time-entry form are absent; boundary: 30-minute midpoint and minimum duration
Test Steps: Drag across row; enter reason on selected block; probe snapping, single click and cancellation; save
Test Data: 960px row; x=400 to x=440; Floor cleaning; midpoint x=449,450,451
Expected Results: Payload contains unavailable 10:00–11:00 with Floor cleaning; drags snap by 30 minutes and one click creates 30 minutes
Test Details: An absent reason, duplicate form, 15-minute snap or zero-length click fails UI and payload assertions.

Acceptance Criteria: Move, resize or delete a stored block then save replacement
Test Scenario: Happy: move and both-edge resize persist in 30-minute steps; error: deletion removes block; boundary: resizing cannot shrink below 30 minutes
Pre-Conditions: Two stored blocks exist for venue 7 on one date
Test Steps: Move block; resize right and left; test minimum duration; delete a block; save each draft
Test Data: 10:00–11:00 moves to 10:30–11:30 then right edge extends to 12:00
Expected Results: Updated rows replace old rows and unrelated block remains
Test Details: Wrong step size, append-only writes, wrong-edge math or broad deletion fail exact block and persisted-row assertions.
